name: Trumpets
overview: The biblical Feast of Trumpets is observed on the first day of the seventh month as a holy convocation marked by the blowing of trumpets and offerings made by fire to the LORD, emphasizing rest from servile work (Leviticus 23:24-25; Numbers 29:1). This day serves as a solemn memorial and a time for the community to gather and worship God. After the captivity, the feast was celebrated with joy and reverence, as seen when Ezra and Nehemiah led the people in hearing the law and encouraging them not to mourn but to recognize the holiness of the day (Nehemiah 8:2, 9).
